clusters.label: TGI / FSO / HAG / sovereign-computing lineage
basis: Global-theorem- and Global-structure- both explicitly center TGI, FSO, Hamiltonian/topological reasoning and the same Z_m^k vocabulary.
Global-structure- contains a detailed TGI system map and FSO geometric-construction material.
Symmetric-HAG explicitly links Global-theorem- and HAG, providing direct cross-repository bridge evidence.
HAG explicitly combines TGI, Closure Lemma, recursive self-improvement, governance and sovereign desktop execution.
Sovereign-OS and STRATOS share sovereign/toroidal/kernel concepts but are not yet established as code lineage.

clusters.label: evidence-governed execution / orchestration
basis: canonical-capability-core explicitly defines capability, authority, evidence, action, durable execution and reconciliation contracts.
Software-res implements evidence collection/validation and deterministic policy decisions with explicit non-claims.
algeria-ai-product-fabric composes evidence, decision, policy and adapter layers around a product vertical.
ai-meta-orchestrator and The-adaptive-methodology both implement orchestration and gated lifecycle concepts.
agentic-apis provides a machine-readable agent tool/API ecosystem that may be an input/resource layer rather than a core implementation.

clusters.label: Algeria multi-agent platform variants
basis: The first two have nearly identical names and overlapping stated mission.
Both describe Algeria-specific automation, orchestration and integrations.
algeria-ai-product-fabric is a broader platform/research monorepo with explicit reusable core and domain/adapters separation.

clusters.label: autonomous trading / revenue systems
basis: Meta-meta defines event-driven trading signals, aggregation, risk checks, portfolio management and backtesting.
AI-Driven-Crypto-Portfolio-Manager defines multi-agent trading orchestration, execution, risk and monitoring.
Drogon contains an AutoRevenue agent application with strategy management and execution-oriented structure.
v0-portfolio-manager-framework appears primarily to be a deployed UI/product surface rather than the trading core.

clusters.label: AI / social / e-commerce marketplace variants
basis: Ai-e-commerce-marketplace explicitly describes an AI-driven social e-commerce marketplace and has backend/frontend/docker/package structure.
AI-Ecommerce-Social-Marketplace2 contains only a minimal README at the inspected revision, so it may be an abandoned or placeholder variant.
Shop-one has a large 345KB README artifact plus GitHub workflows, suggesting a potentially substantial specification or generated project surface requiring deeper inspection.

clusters.label: delivery/logistics application family
basis: smart-delivery-platform-2 explicitly defines a customer/driver/store delivery ecosystem.
The other two names indicate likely related implementations, but their content was not sufficiently inspected in this pass.

clusters.label: security / red-team automation
basis: Global-redteam provides a concrete multi-suite adversarial testing platform with API, fuzzing, property, race and SAST surfaces.
The remaining names strongly suggest a security family but were not all inspected deeply enough to establish lineage.

clusters.label: RL / swarm / experimental agent systems
basis: HiveMind-RL explicitly combines deep RL, graph attention and multi-agent swarm behavior.
Unified-ai explicitly includes RL/HRL, specialized agents, curriculum learning and knowledge-graph memory as an umbrella architecture.
MARL-Pro is currently only minimally documented; training-home requires direct inspection before assigning lineage.
